refinement_hero_only.ask: User: only the rack WITH equipment (the hero) should open, not all six.

refinement_hero_only.qastate_fix: This surfaced a latent bug in __qaState: it read cabinetApis[0] (an EMPTY left-row cabinet), not the hero (index 3). Harmless while all six doors moved together; with only the hero swinging it would report glassDoorAngleActual=0 forever while the on-screen door is wide open — a state object contradicting pixels, the exact failure that hook exists to prevent. Fixed at the source to report the hero.

notes: Inline orchestrator judgment. The user's complaint was exact: the scene never swung, it swapped an opaque door for a transparent one, so 'open' only made the inside clearer. Now the glass+LED door rotates on its hinge with a lerped animation matching the catalog reference, consistent across scene + standalone rack + dashboard, and only the POPULATED cabinet opens (per the follow-up). The change stayed in the DRIVE, not the asset geometry (pivot was already correct), and it earned three good corrections: settle-on-boot so captures aren't mid-arc, splitting a boundary guard that a moving door made obsolete, and fixing a __qaState hook that had been reading the wrong (empty) cabinet all along. Cleared.
